g.text: Joint voltage error, isolated-error sum, and first-order prediction

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #334155

g.text: Saved split-aggregate anchor at 2100 s · six state-conditioned future diagnostic protocols
Signed joint error = predicted voltage from the complete saved estimate − predicted voltage from scoring truth.
One-coordinate errors replace one truth coordinate with its estimate; their sum is not an error bound. The first-order curve uses the truth-anchor Jacobian.
Lines connect the supplied thinned display samples; peak labels use the full 35 Hz metric grid. Each panel has its own y scale.
No voltage assimilation or parameter re-estimation occurs. These curves do not establish uncertainty coverage.
